name: smwmusic-touhou-kikeijuu-wily-beast-and-weakest-creature-broken-heart-of-hellfire-jelly-stone-smw-mix
title: Touhou Kikeijuu ~ Wily Beast and Weakest Creature - Broken Heart of Hellfire ~ Jelly Stone (SMW-Mix)
description:
【﻿ＳＴＯＮＥ】

A remix of Eika Ebisu's theme, Jelly Stone from Touhou 17: Dr. Wily Beast and Weakest Creature. I've been trying to get better at doing unsampled ports (since I rarely upload any), and I wanted to do different take on Eika's theme (more of a hard rock style if you listen closely).

This track can fit in fire stages (such as lava caverns, volcano, etc.) & (final) boss fights.

Important:
There are two customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the txt file:
- B Minor (Original Pitch, set by default)
- C Minor (Custom Pitch)

Update:
9/9/2020 - Fixed tempo to work with AMK 1.0.7
